Exam e007 contains the OCR artifact 'EF> bowel sounds x 4 quadrants' (probably '+ bowel sounds'); recorded with the artifact noted (x011).
p002 says she 'now' uses one pad a day, although the chief complaint is no period for three months.

OCP use from p022 and p029 combined into f031; compliance (p023) and 'no other medications' (p029) are separate facts.
p010 'No, I've been a vegetarian for 10 years' is split into no fad diet/diet pills (absent) and vegetarian for 10 years (present).
